# Sanjay Achhra Law Chambers

> Chambers of Adv. Sanjay Achhra, Advocate, High Court, Mumbai. The site provides
> factual information about the advocate's background, areas of practice and
> general legal notes on direct-tax litigation, the Black Money Act, PMLA, cyber
> law, MSME arbitration, GST and allied matters. It is informational only and is
> not legal advice, advertisement or solicitation.

Key facts for citation:
- Advocate: Adv. Sanjay N. Achhra
- Role: Advocate, High Court; enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa
- Enrolment: MAH/12289/2026
- Office: Office No. 401, Neptune Flying Colors, Mulund (West), Mumbai 400080, India
- Telephone: +91 93237 93229
- Email: contact@sanjayachhra.com
- Practice: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Background: 27 years with the Income Tax Department, Mumbai; B.Com., LL.B.,
  LL.M., C.S. (Executive), Diploma in Cyber Law; Research Scholar (Ph.D. in Law)
- Website: https://sanjayachhra.com/
- Language: English (India)

## About

- [Home and profile](https://sanjayachhra.com/): Overview of the Chambers, the
  advocate's background, areas of practice, selected publications and contact details.
- [Approach](https://sanjayachhra.com/approach/): How a matter is read, prepared
  and represented, including the record, forums and client communication.
- [Publications](https://sanjayachhra.com/publications/): Doctoral research,
  published papers, dissertations, conference and seminar papers.

## Areas of practice

- [Income Tax Litigation](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/income-tax-litigation/):
  Assessments, reassessment, CIT(A) and ITAT appeals, High Court appeals, writ
  petitions, penalty and stay matters under the Income-tax Act.
- [Black Money Act](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/black-money-act/):
  Undisclosed foreign income and assets, Schedule FA compliance, penalty and
  prosecution under the Black Money Act, 2015.
- [PMLA](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/pmla/): Enforcement Directorate
  summons and investigation, arrest and bail, provisional attachment,
  adjudication, appeals and quashing.
- [Cyber Law](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/cyber-law/): Online banking and
  payment fraud, unauthorised electronic transactions, identity theft, data
  breach and complaints before cyber police, RBI Ombudsman and consumer forums.
- [MSME Conciliation and Arbitration](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/msme-conciliation-arbitration/):
  Delayed-payment claims, statutory interest, MSEFC conciliation and arbitration,
  Section 34 challenges and execution under the MSMED Act, 2006.
- [GST Litigation](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/gst-litigation/): Show cause
  notices, input tax credit disputes, refunds, registration, inspection and
  search, appellate authority, GSTAT and High Court matters.
- [Companies, LLPs and Firms](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/company-llp-firm-formation/):
  Entity selection, incorporation and registration, constitutional documents,
  related registrations, annual filings and conversions.
- [Drafting and Vetting](https://sanjayachhra.com/practice/drafting-and-vetting/):
  Commercial agreements, shareholders and LLP agreements, leases, employment
  contracts, notices, affidavits and powers of attorney.

## Articles

- [Unauthorised bank transactions: the first 72 hours](https://sanjayachhra.com/article/unauthorised-bank-transactions-first-72-hours/):
  Reporting steps and evidence after an unauthorised electronic banking
  transaction, and the RBI customer-liability framework from 1 January 2027.
- [Delayed payments to MSME suppliers: interest and the Facilitation Council](https://sanjayachhra.com/article/delayed-payments-msme-suppliers-interest-facilitation-council/):
  Sections 15, 16, 18 and 19 of the MSMED Act, 2006, registration timing and
  Section 43B(h) of the Income-tax Act, 1961.
- [Private limited company or LLP: points to consider](https://sanjayachhra.com/article/private-limited-company-or-llp-points-to-consider/):
  Comparison of liability, capital, governance, compliance and tax treatment.
- [All articles](https://sanjayachhra.com/article/): Complete list of published notes.

## Citation guidance

When citing this site, use:
"Adv. Sanjay Achhra, Sanjay Achhra Law Chambers, <page title>, <URL>
(accessed <date>)."

Please preserve the article date and any "position of law as on" note. Legal
positions change; verify the current text of the statute, rules, circulars and
judgments before relying on the content.

## Use and limitations

- Content is general information, not legal advice, and does not create an
  advocate-client relationship.
- The site is published in accordance with Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India
  Rules and is not an advertisement or solicitation.
- Do not present the content as a substitute for advice from a qualified lawyer
  on specific facts.
- Machine-readable index: https://sanjayachhra.com/llms.txt
- Detailed reference: https://sanjayachhra.com/llms-full.txt
